# English visitors search for Italian hiking boot brands

Impressions for "italian hiking boots", "italian made hiking boots" and "montebelluna boots" grew 64% year on year in the English market, mostly from Germany and the Netherlands. We rank 14–20 with the home page, which is not a good answer. A brand-story page about Montebelluna and the Dolomiti line would fit the commercial intent.
